description: Struggling to clearly communicate how initiatives, tasks, or milestones progress through different stages of a transformation? The Sunray Chart by Datellers is a strategic Power BI custom visual designed to visualize how tasks, milestones, or data flow through different stages of a process or transformation initiative. It helps organizations clearly understand how work progresses across phases, making it easier to monitor progress, communicate strategy, and maintain alignment across teams. In complex programs such as digital transformations, strategic initiatives, or multi-phase projects, it can be difficult to clearly communicate where work is happening and how it evolves over time. The Sunray Chart solves this challenge by visually mapping how activities move through different stages or categories, creating a clear view of transformation progress. This makes it an ideal visualization for business leaders, consultants, and transformation managers who need a simple but powerful way to communicate progress and structure within complex initiatives. Key Benefits Visualize Transformation Flow: Clearly display how tasks, milestones, or initiatives progress through multiple stages or categories.
